key_insight: A shared pretrained model forecasts distributed PV generation across sites and horizons, including unseen stations without local retraining.
engineering_relevance: Fleet-wide forecasting could reduce site-specific model training and maintenance while supporting local adaptation as station data become available.
method: Pretrain on heterogeneous multi-site, multi-horizon PV data.
Frame forecasting as sequence completion using historical power, weather observations, future NWP forecasts, and time encodings.
Combine forecast-aligned and random reconstruction in a mixed reconstruction (MR) objective.
evidence_signal: Experiments used 479 PV stations—340 for model development and 139 spatially held out for zero-shot evaluation—with MR outperforming tested baselines across horizons from 6 hours to 7 days.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical error reductions or deployment costs, limiting assessment of practical gains and operational scalability.
paper_title: Foundation-Style Pretraining for Scalable and Transferable Distributed PV Forecasting
